metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 1963 · High and Low
metas.description: An executive of a Yokohama shoe company becomes a victim of extortion when his chauffeur's son is kidnapped by mistake and held for ransom.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 1962 · To Kill a Mockingbird
metas.description: A widowed lawyer in Depression-era Alabama defends a black man against a false rape charge while teaching his young children about the sad reality of prejudice.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 1960 · Rocco and His Brothers
metas.description: Having recently been uprooted to Milan, Rocco and his four brothers each look for a new way in life when a prostitute comes between Rocco and his brother Simone.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 1969 · Z
metas.description: The public murder of a prominent politician and doctor amid a violent demonstration is covered up by military and government officials. A tenacious magistrate is determined not to let them get away with it.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 1969 · Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid
metas.description: In 1890s Wyoming, Butch Cassidy and The Sundance Kid lead a band of outlaws. When a train robbery goes wrong, they find themselves on the run with a posse hard on their heels..

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 1967 · Cool Hand Luke
metas.description: A laid-back Southern man is sentenced to two years in a rural prison, but refuses to conform.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 1967 · Le Samouraï
metas.description: After professional hitman Jef Costello is seen by witnesses, his efforts to provide himself an alibi drive him further into a corner.
